Launch.fs.reason: Process launcher. The uncovered branch halves are compiler-generated: the null arm of the string pattern and the Process.Start null result, which cannot occur for UseShellExecute=false.

Manifest.fs.reason: Manifest TSV read/write. Round-trip, refusal and error paths are tested; the uncovered branch halves are compiler-generated array-literal and string-split null checks.

PdbCheck.fs.reason: SRM decode check. Both the healthy and the failing path are tested; the remaining branch half is the compiler-generated disposal null check on the `use` bindings.

Weaver.fs.reason: Cecil weaver. Uncovered: the missing-internal-SequencePoint-constructor guard (Cecil is pinned to 0.11.6, which has it), the PdbCorrupt refusal (unreachable once the end-of-method fix is in; PdbCheck's own tests prove the check fires on the unfixed Cecil output), the empty-document-hash arm (the F# compiler always records a SHA256), the unresolvable-attribute name fallback in test detection (the resolver also searches the recorder's directory, which holds xunit in the test host), and compiler-generated null/short-circuit branch halves.

Linux floor, measured line=97.1% branch=83.3% (85/102 branches) with the .NET SDK 10.0.401 CI uses. Line coverage matches macOS (10.0.3xx) exactly; the branch count differs because the newer F# compiler emits different sequence points for the same source (it drops several redundant hidden points, including the end-of-method one), so coverage attributes 16 more branch halves to Weaver.fs. The extra uncovered halves: the missing-SequencePoint-constructor guard and the PdbCorrupt refusal (both explained in the macOS entry), and the null-scope and scope-starts-at-end-of-method halves of the root-scope check (no fixture method lacks a root scope or has one starting at its end).

ContextSource.fs.reason: Fully covered by the recorder's context-source tests.

GitHub ubuntu runner only: measured line=60.4% branch=31.8% (7/22) deterministically, while the same commit measures 100/100 on macOS and in the mcr.microsoft.com/dotnet/sdk:10.0.401 container running CI's exact step order (8/8 repeats, byte-identical recorder DLLs). The runner's per-line data is inconsistent with a single execution (a guarded line is hit while its guard shows 0; closures show 0 while their callers are hit), so the recorder module's counters look merged or overwritten on that runner. Root cause under investigation; this floor is removed once found.

HardLink.fs.reason: Hardlink mirror. Uncovered: the Windows CreateHardLinkW lambda (never runs off Windows; the copy fallback is tested through mirrorWith) and the compiler-generated enumerator-disposal halves of the two `for ... in` loops over sets.

ShadowBin.fs.reason: Shadow bin. Every refusal, the cache hit/miss/corrupt paths, eviction and the weave-set filter are tested. The uncovered branch halves are compiler-generated: enumerator-disposal checks of `for ... in` loops and comprehensions, `use` disposal null checks in the PDB probe, and closure null checks.

JitVerify.fs.reason: JIT verification. Prepared, invalid, generic, abstract, unloadable and malformed lines are all tested. The uncovered halves are compiler-generated: the enumerator-disposal checks of two `for ... in` loops and the null arm of the string pattern.
